seoTitle: sameAs Profile List Builder (Wikidata, Wikipedia, Social)
metaDescription: Clean profile links, Wikipedia pages and Wikidata Q-ids into a sameAs array: https, no tracking parameters, no share links, no duplicates.
intro: Normalises a list of profile URLs, Wikipedia links and Wikidata Q-ids into a clean sameAs array and tells you what each one is.
why:
sameAs links tell search engines that your organization or person is the same entity as a profile elsewhere. The list is usually a mess: http links, mobile Wikipedia URLs, tracking parameters, share buttons pasted by mistake. This tool cleans them up, turns Q-ids into Wikidata URLs, labels each platform and drops duplicates and share links.

It does not look anything up. Finding the right Wikidata item or Wikipedia page for a name needs a live search, which a client-side page cannot do; find the Q-id on wikidata.org and paste it here.
howTo: Paste profile URLs, Q-ids or Wikipedia links, one per line.
Read the notes for each cleaned entry.
Put it in your Organization or Person markup.

faq.q: Why not look up Wikidata for me?
faq.a: That needs a network call to another site, which this page does not make.
Tracking parameters such as utm_ and fbclid, fragments, trailing slashes and share links.

faq.q: Is every link kept as https?

faq.a: Only pages truly about the same entity.
